start.responsibility: Entry-point task node that captures the user's request to design the detailed logic of an e-commerce order processing module (state machine + Saga + layered fallback).
start.implementation: Treated as a pure orchestration origin: it holds the high-level objective and forwards flow to downstream deliverable nodes without carrying domain logic itself.
start.design_intent: Establishes a single, traceable starting point for the design effort so downstream artifact nodes (Mermaid state machine, order-detail sub-graph, high-level abstract steps) can be reasoned about as branches of one explicit ask.
start.constraints: Pure entry node with no domain payload; must not embed implementation specifics; only outgoing edge is to the deliverable — semantic content lives downstream.

deliverable.responsibility: Deliver the final artifact of the order-processing design task: Mermaid source code that pairs a high-level view of the overall order pipeline with an expanded sub-diagram of the order-detail stage.
deliverable.implementation: Typically realized as one or more Mermaid code blocks (stateDiagram / flowchart / sequence) where the main diagram keeps each pipeline step as a single abstract node and the order-detail diagram unpacks that node into a state-machine of order statuses, a Saga sequence of compensating steps, and a layered fallback/retry hierarchy.
deliverable.design_intent: Exists to satisfy a dual-audience deliverable: stakeholders can read the high-level flow to see where order-detail sits in the e-commerce order lifecycle, while implementers can read the detailed sub-diagram to understand the state transitions, distributed-transaction compensation, and graceful-degradation strategy that govern that one critical step.
deliverable.constraints: Must be valid Mermaid that renders; must explicitly combine state-machine + Saga + layered-fallback concepts inside the order-detail sub-diagram; other pipeline steps must remain at high-level abstraction (not over-expanded); the artifact is terminal in the task graph (LeadsTo from start only) so it must be self-contained as the hand-off output.

design-main-flow.responsibility: Produces the top-level Mermaid flowchart skeleton that strings together the six canonical stages of order processing (create-order → order-detail → payment → fulfillment → after-sales → close) as a single readable overview.
design-main-flow.implementation: A design Task that authors a high-level Mermaid diagram (flowchart or sequence flavor) declaring six labeled nodes for the stages and directed edges linking them in order, intentionally kept abstract so it can stand beside — not duplicate — the deeper state-machine, Saga, and fallback expansions produced elsewhere.
design-main-flow.design_intent: Establishes the canonical end-to-end shape of the order journey before any node is opened up in detail, giving downstream work (notably define-main-steps and the order-detail subgraph) a shared backbone to anchor against and to avoid re-litigating the overall topology.
design-main-flow.constraints: Stays strictly at high abstraction — no state-transition internals, Saga choreography, or layered-fallback policies are specified here; uses the same six-stage vocabulary other nodes will reference; renders as a one-glance overview companion to the detailed order-detail expansion rather than competing with it.

define-main-steps.responsibility: 为订单处理主流程中的每个高层步骤定义职责契约（职责、输入输出、失败语义），使主流程图自洽，并为后续展开 order-detail 留出清晰的接缝。
define-main-steps.implementation: 通常以高层列表或带注释的流程节点形式产出：每个步骤给出名称、责任范围、上下游接口（输入/输出契约）、以及失败时的语义约定；其他步骤保持抽象占位，order-detail 作为可展开的引用点挂载详细子图。
define-main-steps.design_intent: 在抽象的主流程设计与具体子模块实现之间架设一个明确的契约层，既保证主流程图自洽可读，又避免提前暴露非 order-detail 步骤的实现细节，从而让 order-detail 的状态机+Saga+分层兜底细节能够在不破坏整体结构的前提下接入。
define-main-steps.constraints: 其他步骤必须保持高层抽象，不展开实现细节；每个步骤必须显式声明失败语义以支撑 Saga 编排；主流程图必须在不引用 order-detail 子图的情况下也能自洽闭合；order-detail 作为唯一的细化点，其契约需与主流程中对它的描述一致。

expand-order-detail.responsibility: Expand the single 'order-detail' step of the e-commerce order pipeline into a self-contained detailed sub-diagram covering its lifecycle states, the Saga steps it coordinates, and the layered fallback strategy, then hand the expanded view off as Mermaid source.
expand-order-detail.implementation: Carried out as a decomposition Task: the high-level order-detail step is unpacked into three orthogonal concerns (state machine, Saga participants, fallback layers), each represented as a section of a Mermaid diagram (stateDiagram and/or flowchart blocks), and the resulting diagram source is the artifact passed downstream to emit-mermaid-source.
expand-order-detail.design_intent: Serves as the 'zoom-in' node in the design flow — it sits between the abstract main-steps overview and the concrete Mermaid artifact, deliberately letting one critical step (order processing) be inspected at full depth while keeping the other pipeline steps at a higher level of abstraction for readability and review.
expand-order-detail.constraints: Only the order-detail step is to be expanded; sibling main steps must remain at high-level abstraction to preserve the overview. The expanded view must consistently address all three concerns named (state machine, Saga orchestration, layered fallback). The emitted diagram must remain valid Mermaid syntax and be derivable from the parent flow without contradicting it.

emit-mermaid-source.responsibility: Emit the final Mermaid source code for the order processing design, combining the main end-to-end flowchart with an expanded order-detail subgraph (state machine and Saga sequence diagram).
emit-mermaid-source.implementation: Typically realized as a synthesis step that collects diagram fragments produced by upstream design tasks (including the order-detail expansion) and assembles them into a single Mermaid document — a top-level flowchart plus one or more subgraphs rendered as stateDiagram-v2 and sequenceDiagram blocks.
emit-mermaid-source.design_intent: Serves as the terminal delivery point of the design pipeline, turning intermediate design decisions into a concrete, readable diagram artifact that downstream consumers (documentation, reviews, code generation) can consume directly. The split between a high-level main flow and a detailed order-detail subgraph is meant to keep the overall view legible while exposing the state-machine and Saga choreography only where complexity warrants it.
emit-mermaid-source.constraints: Must keep steps other than order-detail at a high level of abstraction; the order-detail subgraph must be the only place where state-machine transitions and Saga choreography details are made explicit; output is expected to be valid Mermaid syntax that can be rendered as-is.
